data.description:
### Save $30 on the Ultimate San Diego Adventure: Scooter & Speedboat Combo!

Explore the best of San Diego with our **Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo** and save $30! This exciting two-part experience gives you the freedom to discover San Diego’s hidden gems while offering the thrill of speeding across San Diego Bay.

#### **Part 1: Explore San Diego on the World’s First Storytelling Scooter**
Hop on a scooter and embark on a self-guided adventure around San Diego at your own pace. Our one-of-a-kind storytelling scooter will be your guide, cracking jokes and sharing fascinating stories about the city’s history and culture. Go where traditional tour buses can’t, uncovering the secret spots that most visitors never get to see!

#### **Part 2: Speed Boat Adventure on San Diego Bay**
After your scooter ride, get ready for an adrenaline-pumping **2-hour Speed Boat Adventure**. You’ll be the captain of your own speedboat as you follow a professional guide through the beautiful San Diego Bay. Zoom past incredible sights like nuclear submarines, aircraft carriers, and more – with every tour offering something new and exciting to discover.

#### **Why Choose This Combo?**
- **Save $30** when you book both adventures together
- See parts of San Diego that tour buses don’t reach
- Enjoy the thrill of driving your own speedboat on a guided tour
- Tours can be scheduled on different days to fit your itinerary

#### **Booking Made Easy**
Choose your **Speedboat Adventure** date and time online, then call us to schedule your scooter tour for a time that suits you!

This combo offers the perfect mix of sightseeing, fun, and adventure – the ultimate way to spend a day in San Diego. Book now and create unforgettable memories!
data.highlights:
The **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour** stands out as one of the most unique ways to experience San Diego, blending land exploration with a thrilling water adventure. The scooter portion of the tour is not your average city tour—riders are guided by a GPS-enabled, storytelling scooter, allowing them to explore major attractions like **Balboa Park**, **Little Italy**, and the **Gaslamp Quarter** at their own pace. This offers an intimate and customizable experience, with the freedom to stop and enjoy the sights as long as you like, while the GPS system shares interesting historical facts and anecdotes that bring San Diego to life.

On the water, the excitement kicks up a notch with a two-hour guided speedboat tour of **San Diego Bay**. What makes this part of the tour truly special is the hands-on experience—you're in control of your own speedboat, following a professional guide who leads you past some of the most famous sights in San Diego, like the **USS Midway**, **Navy ships**, and the **Coronado Bridge**. Along the way, you might spot seals and other marine wildlife, adding to the adventure and scenic beauty of the trip. The speedboat portion perfectly complements the scooter tour, offering a complete San Diego experience from two perspectives: land and sea.

The flexibility of the **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Combo Tour** is another major draw. You can take both tours on the same day or split them across multiple days, making it ideal for busy travelers or locals looking to spread out the fun. This combination of flexibility, personalization, and adventure is what makes this tour stand out in a sea of typical city tours. Whether you’re cruising through the streets on your scooter or captaining your own boat across the bay, this tour offers an unforgettable way to see San Diego's top landmarks while engaging in an interactive and exciting experience.
data.itinerary:
### Itinerary for the GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour:

#### **1. Start Your Adventure with the GPS-Guided Scooter Tour**
- **Arrival & Check-In**: Begin your day by picking up your electric scooter at the designated location in San Diego. After a quick orientation on how the GPS-guided scooter works, you’ll be ready to start exploring.
- **Explore San Diego**: Ride through iconic locations such as **Balboa Park**, **Little Italy**, the **Gaslamp Quarter**, and other landmarks. Your scooter provides live narration, sharing historical facts, jokes, and interesting stories as you pass various attractions.
- **Duration**: This part of the tour can last about 1-2 hours, allowing you to explore San Diego at your own pace.

#### **2. Transition to the Speedboat Adventure**
- **Head to the Marina**: After your scooter tour, head to the **Safe Harbor Cabrillo Isle Marina** for the second part of your adventure. The transition between the tours typically requires at least one hour.
- **Guided Speedboat Tour**: After a short briefing, you’ll hop into your own speedboat and follow a professional guide through San Diego Bay. Cruise past major sights like the **USS Midway**, **Navy ships**, the **Coronado Bridge**, and playful seals. Your guide will provide commentary as you enjoy the scenic views.
- **Duration**: The speedboat tour lasts approximately 2 hours.

#### **End of Tour**: 
You’ll finish up at the marina after a thrilling ride on the bay. The tours do not need to be taken on the same day, so you have flexibility in how you schedule your adventure.

data.what_to_bring:
Customers should bring the following items for the **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour**:

1. **Valid ID and Credit Card**:
   - A valid driver's license is required for the scooter portion, and the credit card used to make the reservation.
   
2. **Comfortable Clothing**:
   - Wear comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing. It's recommended to bring layers, as temperatures can change, especially during the speedboat portion of the tour on the bay.

3. **Sunscreen & Sunglasses**:
   - San Diego can be sunny, so sunscreen and sunglasses are essential to protect from UV exposure, especially while on the water during the speedboat ride.

4. **Footwear**:
   - Comfortable, flat shoes are recommended for both the scooter tour and getting in and out of the speedboat.

5. **Water Bottle**:
   - Stay hydrated throughout the tour, particularly if you’re doing both portions on the same day.

6. **Waiver**:
   - Complete the online waiver ahead of time or bring it signed to save time during check-in. 

These items will ensure you have a comfortable, safe, and enjoyable experience on the tour.

data.check_in_details:
### Check-In Instructions for the **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour**:

#### **1. Scooter Tour Check-In**:
- **Location**: The scooter portion of the tour begins at **3918 Mason St., San Diego, CA 92110**.
- **Arrival Time**: Please arrive **15-20 minutes before** your scheduled tour time for check-in and a brief orientation on how the GPS-guided scooter works.
- **What to Bring**: You’ll need to bring a **valid driver's license** and **credit card**. You will also be required to sign a participant agreement upon arrival.
- **Waiver**: Be sure to sign the online waiver before arriving to speed up the check-in process.
- **Additional Information**: Feel free to extend the length of your scooter tour on the day of the rental for an additional fee (billed in 15-minute increments).

#### **2. Speedboat Tour Check-In**:
- **Location**: The speedboat tour starts at **Safe Harbor Cabrillo Isle Marina, 1450 Harbor Island Dr. #205, San Diego, CA 92101**.
- **Arrival Time**: Arrive at the marina **at least 20 minutes before** your scheduled speedboat tour.
- **What to Bring**: No special boating license is required, but participants must be at least **18 years old** to drive the boat. Don’t forget to bring **sunglasses, sunscreen**, and **comfortable clothing** suitable for the boat ride.
- **Safety Briefing**: Before starting, you’ll receive a brief safety and instructional session on boating basics, rules of the road, and hand signals.

#### **3. Tour Timing**:
- **Same-Day Tours**: If you're doing both the scooter and speedboat tours on the same day, make sure to allow at least **one hour** between finishing the scooter tour and starting the speedboat adventure for a smooth transition.
- **Different-Day Tours**: If you’re splitting the tours across different days, just call the provided phone number after your booking to confirm both portions of the tour.
data.special_requirements:
For the **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour**, the health and safety requirements are as follows:

1. **Scooter Tour Health Requirements**:
   - Participants must be at least **13 years old** to drive the scooter.
   - A valid driver’s license is required.
   - While no strenuous physical activity is required, participants should be comfortable operating a scooter and able to follow traffic rules.

2. **Speedboat Tour Health Requirements**:
   - Drivers must be at least **18 years old**, and passengers should be at least **5 years old**.
   - No special boating license is required, but participants should be in good health to safely operate a speedboat.
   - Participants should be able to physically handle driving a small speedboat, which requires some steering and throttle control.
   - Pregnant individuals or those with serious back or neck issues are typically advised not to participate due to the physical activity involved in driving the boat and potential bumps during the ride.

These requirements help ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all participants.

data.faqs:
Here are some frequently asked questions (FAQs) for the **GPS-Guided Scooter & Speedboat Adventure Combo Tour**:

### **1. Do I need a special license to drive the scooter or speedboat?**
- **Scooter**: No, a **valid driver's license** is not required to rent and drive the scooter.
- **Speedboat**: No, you don’t need a special boating license, but participants must be at least **18 years old** to drive the speedboat..

### **2. How many people can ride in a scooter or speedboat?**
- **Scooter**: The scooter is designed for **one rider**.
- **Speedboat**: Each boat accommodates up to **two passengers** and one driver.

### **3. What should I wear for the tour?**
- Wear **comfortable clothing**, **flat shoes**, and bring **sunscreen** and **sunglasses**. It’s also recommended to dress in layers, as temperatures can change, especially on the water.

### **4. What happens if the weather is bad?**
- In case of bad weather, the tour may be canceled. You will have the option to **reschedule**, receive a **gift card**, or get a **full refund**.

### **5. Can I take both tours on different days?**
- Yes, the tours do not need to be taken on the same day. You can schedule the scooter and speedboat tours on different days if that works better for your itinerary.

### **6. Is there a safety briefing before the speedboat tour?**
- Yes, before the speedboat tour, there will be a **briefing on boating basics**, including rules of the road, hand signals, and safety procedures

### **7. Can children participate in the tour?**
- **Scooter**: Riders must be at least **13 years old** to drive the scooter.
- **Speedboat**: Children must be at least **5 years old** to ride as passengers in the speedboat and must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

These FAQs cover the essential information participants need to know before booking and enjoying the tour.
